stem: Which movement is taking place at the same time that this ridge is forming?

options.label: A
options.text: The North American and Eurasian plates are moving toward each other.

options.label: B
options.text: The North American plate is moving on top of the Eurasian plate.

options.label: C
options.text: The North American and Eurasian plates are moving away from each other.

options.label: D
options.text: The North American and Eurasian plates are sliding past each other.

visual_elements: Map showing Mid-Atlantic Ridge running between North American plate and Eurasian plate with Iceland near the ridge.
